text:
Sam (Sales): FYI passing Halo Labs to CS — signed enterprise deal, 100 seats, wants private deployment by EOM.
Maya (CS): Thanks! Quick context please — main risks we should track?
Sam (Sales): Main asks: VPC deploy, SSO via SAML, HIPAA dataset isolation, and a pilot integration with their inference pipeline. They want a 6-month ROI check for renewal.
Maya (CS): Noted. Who owns SSO + infra handshake?
Sam (Sales): Liam (pre-sale infra) did initial scoping. Liam, can you confirm constraints?
Liam (Eng): Saw the scoping notes. They'll need a CIDR allocation and a jump box for our deploy. SAML is standard. Two concerns: (1) custom model variant they want to test may require 2x GPU capacity; (2) on-prem option needs an air-gapped installer which we haven't shipped as a GA.
Maya (CS): Thanks — adding to risk log. Renewal risk: medium-high until pilot proves cost/perf.
Devon (Support): Heads-up: support will need access matrix and contact list for their infra team. Also want to pre-create a runbook for the pilot.
Maya (CS): I'll own runbook and enablement sessions. Proposed owners:
• CS lead: Maya — onboarding, enablement, weekly check-ins
• Technical lead: Liam — infra/SSO/producer validation
• Support contact: Devon — escalation path + runbook maintenance
• Customer success manager: Sam (Sales) will remain point-of-contact for contract ops
Sam (Sales): Small correction — I'll be account exec but handoff will include Alex (customer-side PM).
Maya (CS): Action items and due dates:
• Create onboarding runbook draft — Maya — due in 48h
• Send SSO metadata request to Halo Labs — Maya — today
• Confirm GPU sizing & queueing policy — Liam — 72h
• Pre-create support runbook template + escalation contacts — Devon — 72h
• Schedule 2-hour pilot kick-off call with engineering — Maya/Liam — by 3/23
OnboardBot: Onboarding checklist created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/halo-labs (checklist id: OB-4382)
Sam (Sales): Dropping initial customer contacts: alex@halolabs.com (PM), ops@halolabs.com (infra), cto@halolabs.com. Alex prefers Tue mornings.
Maya (CS): Noted — I'll ping Alex and ops to get SAML metadata and a short inventory of their inference workload (seq lengths, peak rps).
Liam (Eng): For the custom model test: please ask them to provide a small sample model + 2 representative payloads. If quantization needed we'll map perf delta.
Devon (Support): I'll prepare a minimal runbook skeleton. Suggest sections: access, SSO steps, known-errors, contact matrix, rollback.
Maya (CS): Capture of customer feedback loop: we'll run weekly enablement surveys and a post-pilot NPS. I'll add a feedback capture card to the runbook and link it to an eval prompt set.
Sam (Sales): Any legal/compliance blockers? They requested a sub-process for data deletion within 30 days of contract end.
Maya (CS): Legal flagged a template clause for data retention. Sam please share the signed contract copy to legal@redwood for offline review.
Liam (Eng): One more technical note: if they push large KV caches we should cap per-tenant cache to avoid OOM. I'll propose config defaults in the infra ticket.
Maya (CS): OK — next sync in 48h. Summary of immediate owners: Maya (runbook + enablement), Liam (infra + sizing), Devon (support runbook), Sam (customer ops + contract).
Sam (Sales): Great — thanks everyone. @Maya please DM me once runbook is up and I'll intro Alex. :thumbsup:
Maya (CS): Will do. Creating the initial runbook now and will post updates in this thread.
OnboardBot: Runbook OB-4382 updated by Maya (CS) — sections: kickoff, SAML steps, infra checklist, pilot success criteria.
Devon (Support): I'll review the runbook tomorrow and add the escalation matrix.
Liam (Eng): I'll open infra ticket INF-7891 for VPC and GPU sizing and link it here.
Maya (CS): Closing notes: Pilot success criteria (to be added to runbook): 1) <20% latency regression vs their baseline, 2) stable for 48h at expected peak, 3) SSO completed with 0 critical issues. Renewal readiness checkpoint at month 5.
Sam (Sales): Sounds good. Thanks all.
Maya (CS): Thread locked for action items — I'll post a status update in 48 hours.
